propositions: A `recheck-review` comment token triggers contributor-initiated re-review of non-finding LLM-Review verdicts without requiring a new patchset push.

The trigger must refuse and reply with no enqueue/budget-reset/vote-change when the current revision carries an actual `[LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding]` tag (including merge-change form), blocking dice-rolled self-approval.

Eligibility is decided privileged-side by parsing the bot's durable Gerrit change message tag (current revision only), covering all three production tag shapes: _TAG_SUFFIXES members, hardcoded merge-review literal, and in-tag (merge-change, N) suffix.

Comment-added event routing in app.py worker and new retrigger.py module must ignore bot-authored comments, match the recheck-review token (word boundary, not substring), and reset the 0347 retry budget before enqueueing with _rebar_force.
The Gerrit REST calls for fetching messages and posting replies must omit the `labels` key entirely to avoid vote writes, enforced by unit test assertion on serialized request body.

The trigger applies uniformly to coverage-gap sub-reasons (llm-unavailable, review-error, scanner, indeterminate, gate-disabled) and bounded-retry escalations, treating unparseable/absent tags as fail-open eligible for a fresh review.
